description: This is our handmade 7" Bloom shaped crochet doily in beige. This doily is made from 100% cotton and adds style to your everyday tabletops. Use our doilies for every DIY craft projects, we have included a few photos to show you the different ideas we created with our cotton doilies. Our creative staff here at Paper Lantern Store has created a fruit bowl and a doily garland with some fabric stiffener. The ideas are endless, but this gives you some ideas of how to use doilies besides using them as everyday table placemats.
